title: Are squats bad for your knees? 🦵
caption:
Reviews found deep squats do not damage healthy knees; the forces are well within what they can handle, and squatting strengthens the muscles and tendons that protect them. Knees past toes is normal. Knee pain? Lower the weight, check form, see a physio. Squat day this week? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Gym Myths Busted #7
first_comment: Who was told "squats will ruin your knees" by someone who never squatted? 😅
sources: Hartmann H, Wirth K, Klusemann M. Analysis of the load on the knee joint and vertebral column with changes in squatting depth and weight load. Sports Med 2013;43:993-1008
Escamilla RF. Knee biomechanics of the dynamic squat exercise. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2001;33:127-141
Fry AC, Smith JC, Schilling BK. Effect of knee position on hip and knee torques during the barbell squat. J Strength Cond Res 2003;17:629-633
